description_en: Retrieves the details of an event
name: GetTopic

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the event. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173973.html to obtain the ID.

The documentation example is for format demonstration only. Valid TopicId values can be obtained from Data.Topics[].TopicId in the ListTopics response
parameters.help_zh:
事件的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173973.html获取。

文档示例仅用于展示格式；有效 TopicId 可通过 ListTopics 响应中的 Data.Topics[].TopicId 获取
parameters.name: topic_id

AddTime.description_en: The timestamp when the event was discovered

AlertTime.description_en: The timestamp of the first alert

Assigner.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the assigner

BaselineBuffer.description_en: The buffer of the worst baseline instance, in seconds
BaselineBuffer.description_zh: 最差基线实例余量，单位为秒

BaselineId.description_en: The baseline ID of the worst baseline instance

BaselineInGroupId.description_en: The cycle number of the worst baseline instance
BaselineInGroupId.description_zh: 最差基线实例的周期号

BaselineName.description_en: The baseline name of the worst baseline instance
BaselineName.description_zh: 最差基线实例的基线名称

BaselineStatus.description_en: The status of the baseline. Valid values: ERROR, SAFE, DANGROUS (warning), and OVER (exceeded)
BaselineStatus.description_zh: 基线的状态，包括ERROR（异常）、SAFE（安全）、DANGROUS（预警）和OVER（破线）

Buffer.description_en: The buffer of the event, in seconds

DealTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last handling

DealUser.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the last handler

FixTime.description_en: The timestamp when the event was resolved

HappenTime.description_en: The timestamp when the event occurred. There may be a time difference between when the event occurred and when it was discovered
HappenTime.description_zh: 事件发生的时间戳。事件发生和被发现可能存在时间差

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID associated with the event

NextAlertTime.description_en: The timestamp of the next alert

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the node associated with the event

NodeName.description_en: The name of the node associated with the event
NodeName.description_zh: 事件关联的任务节点名称

Owner.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the event owner

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the node associated with the event belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 事件关联任务节点所在工作空间的ID

TopicStatus.description_en: The status of the event. Valid values: IGNORE (ignored), NEW (newly discovered), FIXING (being handled), and RECOVER (recovered)
TopicStatus.description_zh: 事件的状态，包括IGNORE（已忽略）、NEW（新发现）、FIXING（处理中）和RECOVER（已恢复）

TopicType.description_en: The type of the event. Valid values: SLOW and ERROR
TopicType.description_zh: 事件的类型，包括SLOW（变慢）和ERROR（出错）

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
